annotations.title: What changed on my MCP servers (7Maps)

description: Use this to check all the MCP servers you depend on in one call instead of one by one: give up to 50 servers and the date of your last check, and get only what changed since then (outages, recoveries, tools added, removed or changed, risk increases, silent changes). Most answers are "nothing changed". Which to use: changes_since for up to 50 servers at once; watch for one server; verify_lock against a saved lock. Paid per call (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

servers.description: Server URLs or official registry names

since.description: Date of your last check (YYYY-MM-DD); up to 30 days back
